prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Spectrum 2-3: page #FBF9FA, text #2D211F, accent #86851D, secondary surface #E7EFE8, text on accent #111111. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Work Sans; traditional serif with flexible sans reading text. Composition: Chronological entries with dates on a shared rail, compact media, explicit sequence. Use body 20px, heading 28px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
